entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:2
segments: Wicked men who give themselves up to the service of the devil, may be suffered by God to do many strange and unaccountable things.  But no one should hearken to them, or in any way give them encouragement.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:3
segments:
Proveth you; by suffering the false prophets to do some strange and wonderful things, and thus to tempt them to forsake God and worship idols. 
 
God suffers many things to take place in this world to try men, and lead them to show whether they will serve him or not.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:5
segments: Turn you away from the Lord; as he was the King of the Jews, idolatry was treason, and punishable with death.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:8
segments: We must not suffer our nearest relatives or most intimate friends to lead us into sin, nor must we in any way connive at their transgressions.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:9
segments:
Kill him; when proved to be guilty by legal process according to divine directions. 
 
  Be first upon him; the accusers and witnesses were to cast the first stones.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:11
segments: One object of punishment is to express the wrath of God against crime, and thus restrain others from committing it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:16
segments: Burn--every whit; this was to cut off all temptation to avarice, and to express the utmost abhorrence of the crime.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:17
segments: Men should show a deep abhorrence of crime by suitably punishing it, and in executing God's wrath against the guilty they should, both in reality and in appearance, be influenced only by holy and benevolent motives.
